name: RNIT Al Solutions Limited
about: RNIT Al Solutions Limited, a tech company, focuses on providing enterprise-level solutions in India and internationally. It offers various solutions, including artificial intelligence (AI) based facial identification system, Internet of Things (IoT), data analytics, digital transformation, and open-source enterprise resource planning. It also provides real time identification and digital inspection management system; education management system; health department management system; Faceify, an AI based facial recognition-based enterprise resource planning for corporates; mpred, predictive analytics paves way for proactive medical care and prevention; remote endpoint management system; real time face monitoring and alerting system; and facial terminals. RNIT Al Solutions Limited was incorporated in 2019 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
